title: Electricity Union Threatens Nationwide Strike Over Alleged Assault in Edo
summary: NUEE has threatened a nationwide blackout if security agents fail to return seized items and leave the BEDC premises in Edo State following an alleged assault on its leaders.
paragraphs: The National Union of Electricity Employees has threatened to launch a nationwide strike following the alleged assault of its officials in Edo State. According to Punch, the labor body gave security personnel a one-day ultimatum to return seized belongings and withdraw armed forces from the regional distribution headquarters.

Trouble started when security agents reportedly attacked and detained the Edo union chairman, William Uwumarogie, alongside Matthew Eromobor in Benin. Punch revealed that both men were seized during an evening vigil outside company premises while protesting over inadequate pay, poor working conditions, and safety problems.

Although security agents freed the victims on Friday morning, union official David Ehigiamusoe stated that both men require ongoing medical treatment. NUEE warned that failure to meet their operational demands will result in an immediate shut down of power infrastructure across the entire country.
sensitive_reason: Allegations of physical assault, illegal arrest, and hospitalisation involving security forces and union leaders.
